name: USI Corporation
summary: USI Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells polyethylene plastic pellets in Asia, the Americas, Europe, Africa, Oceania, and internationally. It offers ethylene vinyl acetate copolymers, medium and low-density polyethylene, high density polyethylene resin, and cyclic block copolymers; industrial and architectural paints and coatings; and optical products and fireproof materials business.
